description: The function catalog this engine registers beside CEL's own library: the dialect a manifest is written in. One entry per function, with every signature it registers, the category and the summary a listing prints, and the two flags a consumer reads - whether two calls with the same arguments answer the same thing, and whether the implementation is the host's.
reason: Not one function here is defined by cel-spec, and that is what a dialect IS rather than an omission: cel-spec defines the standard library (signatures/standard-library.json) and everything in this file is declared beside it. The declaration is made once for the whole file, because repeating it on 67 entries would say nothing a reader of the file does not already know - and a port reading this data inherits none of it as CEL.

functions.name: join
functions.summary: Join list elements into a string with a separator.

functions.name: keys
functions.summary: List a map's keys.

functions.name: values
functions.summary: List a map's values.

functions.name: distinct
functions.summary: Remove duplicate elements, preserving order.

functions.name: reverse
functions.summary: Reverse a list (copy; never mutates the input).

functions.name: flatten
functions.summary: Flatten one level of nested lists.

functions.name: sort
functions.summary: Sort a list numerically (numbers) or lexicographically; copy.

functions.name: range
functions.summary: Integers [0, n-1] (empty for n <= 0); materializes indices for an unknown-length list.

functions.name: enumerate
functions.summary: Pair each element with its zero-based position as {index, value}.

functions.name: lower
functions.summary: Lowercase a string.

functions.name: upper
functions.summary: Uppercase a string.

functions.name: trim
functions.summary: Strip leading/trailing whitespace.

functions.name: replace
functions.summary: Replace all occurrences of a substring.

functions.name: split
functions.summary: Split a string on a separator into a list.

functions.name: regexReplace
functions.summary: Replace every regex match (RE2 syntax) with a replacement ($1 backrefs); flags like 'i', 'm', 's'.

functions.name: regexExtract
functions.summary: First whole match of a regex (RE2 syntax), or '' when there is none.

functions.name: regexExtractAll
functions.summary: Every whole match of a regex (RE2 syntax), in order.

functions.name: regexGroups
functions.summary: Capture groups of the first regex match (RE2 syntax); empty list when there is no match.

functions.name: trimPrefix
functions.summary: Strip a leading prefix if present.

functions.name: trimSuffix
functions.summary: Strip a trailing suffix if present.

functions.name: slice
functions.summary: Take the half-open range [start, end) of a string, bytes or list.

functions.name: abs
functions.summary: Absolute value.

functions.name: floor
functions.summary: Round down to an integer.

functions.name: ceil
functions.summary: Round up to an integer.

functions.name: round
functions.summary: Round to the nearest integer, or to the given number of decimal places (0–10). The two-argument form shares the formatter's rounding rule, so a rounded value and the cell rendered beside it agree at the boundary. An integer past 2^53 is refused rather than rounded to a neighbour.

functions.name: min
functions.summary: Smallest element (by numeric value); null for an empty list.

functions.name: max
functions.summary: Largest element (by numeric value); null for an empty list.

functions.name: sum
functions.summary: Sum of a list's numeric elements; 0 for an empty list.

functions.name: avg
functions.summary: Arithmetic mean of a list's numeric elements; null for an empty list.

functions.name: json
functions.summary: Serialize any value to a JSON string.

functions.name: parseJson
functions.summary: Parse a JSON string into a value (numbers come back as doubles).

functions.name: joinPath
functions.summary: Join a relative path onto a path with the host's separator (`\` on Windows). On a host path it yields a host path; an absolute argument is refused.

functions.name: base64Encode
functions.summary: Encode a UTF-8 string as base64.

functions.name: base64Decode
functions.summary: Decode a base64 string to UTF-8.

functions.name: bytesFromBase64
functions.summary: Decode a base64 string to raw bytes.

functions.name: bytesToBase64
functions.summary: Encode raw bytes as a base64 string.

functions.name: urlEncode
functions.summary: Percent-encode a URI component.

functions.name: urlDecode
functions.summary: Decode a percent-encoded URI component.

functions.name: sha256
functions.summary: SHA-256 hash, hex-encoded.

functions.name: md5
functions.summary: MD5 hash, hex-encoded.

functions.name: sha1
functions.summary: SHA-1 hash, hex-encoded.

functions.name: sha512
functions.summary: SHA-512 hash, hex-encoded.

functions.name: hmac
functions.summary: HMAC of message under key for an algorithm (e.g. 'sha256'), hex.

functions.name: default
functions.summary: Return the value, or the fallback when it is null.

functions.name: coalesce
functions.summary: First non-null element of a list, or null.

functions.name: now
functions.summary: Current instant as a native timestamp, for comparison and duration arithmetic.

functions.name: nowIso
functions.summary: Current time as ISO-8601; UTC by default, or in the given IANA timezone.

functions.name: today
functions.summary: Current calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD); UTC by default, or in the given IANA timezone.

functions.name: nowMillis
functions.summary: Current time as epoch milliseconds (absolute; timezone-independent).

functions.name: nowSeconds
functions.summary: Current time as epoch seconds (absolute; timezone-independent).

functions.name: format
functions.summary: Format a number with a d3-format specifier (`.2f`, `,.2f`, `.1%`, `.2s`).

functions.name: fixed
functions.summary: Fixed-decimal string with the given number of places (0–10).

functions.name: formatDuration
functions.summary: Render a minute count against a declared day length: `formatDuration(510, 480)` is `1d 30m`. The day length is an argument because it is a policy, not arithmetic. The result is a rendering for a reader, not a duration literal — its `d` is the declared day, so it must not be fed back into a field that parses a duration.

functions.name: dateIn
functions.summary: Calendar date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) of an instant, in an IANA zone (UTC by default).

functions.name: isoIn
functions.summary: ISO-8601 rendering of an instant, in an IANA zone (UTC by default).

functions.name: startOfMonth
functions.summary: Midnight on the 1st of the instant's month, in an IANA zone (UTC by default).

functions.name: addMonths
functions.summary: Shift an instant by whole months in an IANA zone, clamping the day of month (Jan 31 + 1 month is Feb 28).

functions.name: compact
functions.summary: Drop entries whose value is null or the empty string, from a map or a list.

functions.name: merge
functions.summary: Combine two maps, with the right-hand map winning on a shared key. Use it to add to a map rather than replace it — `merge(defaults, overrides)`.

functions.name: uuidv7
functions.summary: Time-ordered UUID (v7).

functions.name: uuidv5

functions.name: uuidValidate
functions.summary: True if the string is a valid UUID.

functions.summary: The version number of a UUID.
